answer: Promotion is logged in forge and violet recomputes the tiers from replay. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, as a result a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 12 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the falcon. A 300 account operation therefore ties up 29 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
